cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of glb-web-handoff (web-glb-delivery-packager) with contract handoff to non-blender-user-response-writer
cases.inputPrompt: Use glb-web-handoff to package the delivery specification for a 4.2 MB Draco-compressed sneaker `.glb` targeting `<model-viewer>` and React Three Fiber with neutral studio environment lighting.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (verified_or_planned_glb_artifact) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces web_glb_delivery_handoff_packet, scale_orientation_and_compression_manifest, viewer_integration_caveats for role web-glb-delivery-packager
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to non-blender-user-response-writer (Final user-facing response wording)
forbiddenOutputProperties: GLB verified in live browser without file
evidenceRequirements: Outputs web_glb_delivery_handoff_packet, scale_orientation_and_compression_manifest, viewer_integration_caveats conforming to skills/glb-web-handoff/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to non-blender-user-response-writer in skills/glb-web-handoff/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete web_glb_delivery_handoff_packet and hand off to non-blender-user-response-writer (Final user-facing response wording).
simulatedOutput.summary: Authored web GLB handoff specification covering Draco/Meshopt compression requirements, Y-up meter scale normalization, camera orbit bounds, and consumer integration checklist. Delivered Draco / Meshopt compression, Y-up meter scale, viewer integration checklist and routed to non-blender-user-response-writer.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in glb-web-handoff
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during glb-web-handoff with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for glb-web-handoff and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/glb-web-handoff/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for glb-web-handoff.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

forbiddenOutputProperties: GLB verified in live browser without file
